pit.CRSP: Ph1b sHTG (n=10) showed day-30 TG -63%, ANGPTL3 -65%, no pancreatitis; durable at 90 days in 7 pts. At $3.9B cap is 3.7x $1.1B weighted peak, and CRISPR holds 40% of Casgevy economics.
pit.AUTL: AUCATZYL FY26 guide is $140-150M and lupus has RMAT, so a $304M cap leaves optionality lightly priced; catch is $248M cash vs $360M debt and ~6.9 quarters of runway.
pit.LYEL: Ronde-cel held CR at 75% at 12 months w ASH oral data on Dec 14 (80+ pts) and pivotal data mid-2027; cap $485M vs $194M cash plus $80M placement, in a crowded CD19 CAR-T field.
pit.SNDX: Q3 revenue of $60.7M (+90% y/y) puts Revuforj near a $240M run-rate against an $822M cap; $551M cash roughly offsets $594M debt, so frontline data guided for Q4 2026 sets upside.
pit.IMMX: NEXICART-2 interim: 40/45 CR, no neurotoxicity, Breakthrough/RMAT; one-year follow-up by Mar 2027. $341M cash after a $125M raise covers 53% of $645M cap.
pit.ANTX: Repositioned epetraborole has no human PV efficacy; enrollment starts by YE26 and Part 1 data trickle through 2027. A $206M cap is 2.6x cash, so option is priced modestly.
pit.PTGX: Icotrokinra (6-10% royalty) and rusfertide (14-29%) are both approved and a $300M buyback is authorized, yet $9.0B is ~3.6x $2.5B peak estimate, so uptake must beat expectations.
pit.XLO: A $152M cap against $122M cash leaves little priced into XTX501 (first patient dosed Oct 2026; NSCLC data Q4 2027). IL-2 has a history of toxicity failures, so masking must show a real therapeutic index.
pit.ELTX: Ph2 missed its ITT DFS primary and R0 subgroup (HR 0.65, p=0.048) is nominal; $24M cash vs a $37M cap means a Ph3 needs financing data may not support.
pit.RXRX: TUPELO 13/15 polyp reduction, median -47%; rare orphan FAP; $1.7B cap vs $562M cash.
pit.IBRX: Q3 revenue of $48.7M (+53% YoY) and a papillary label expansion are real, yet $6.6B cap is 5.1x our $1.3B peak, w $1.3B debt vs $334M cash and cretostimogene closing in.
pit.TARA: Stock at exactly cash ($143M) w Breakthrough status and 72% CR any-time (~55% at 12 mo, n=31); differentiation is BCG-sparing, not superior efficacy, and 6.6 quarters of cash is tight.
pit.JANX: The $689M cap sits below $946M of cash, leaving PSMA x CD3 platform free: 30% PR (8/27), rPFS 7.9-8.9mo, no Grade 3 CRS, but earlier BiTEs failed on CRS and next data is 1H 2027.
pit.OLMA: Cash of $414M covers 56% of $744M cap into binary OPERA-01 topline (Q1 2027, slipped from fall 2026); cap is 0.7x our weighted peak, but elacestrant and camizestrant set bar.
pit.ATOS: 26.5% breast-density cut matching tamoxifen is a biomarker, not an outcome, and financing may precede EVANGELINE data; a cash-backed show-me story, trading below $26M cash.
pit.ZNTL: Cyclin E1+ PROC showed median OS 15.9 mo (n=48) vs 7.5 mo in E1-; w pivotal topline slipped to 1H 2027 and only ~5 quarters of runway, cap sits below cash but financing looms.
pit.NXTC: Pending Avere merger leaves legacy holders ~2%, so real bet is a late oral IL-23 entrant w Ph2b data ~1H 2028, whatever screen shows from a $29M cap vs $400M cash.
pit.CRBP: CRB-701 posted 42.9% cORR in 2L OPSCC and 34.4% in cervical (n=317 safety set); cash is 1.6x $70M cap, but Astellas/Pfizer's EV is 2+ years ahead and 1L combo data land Q1 2027.
pit.CGEM: After netting $314M cash, ~$300M of value rides on CLN-978 (10/14 SLE pts w a 4+ point hSLEDAI drop at EULAR, one Grade 3 CRS); December multi-dose data and Feb 27 zipalertinib PDUFA are next.
pit.WHWK: HWK-007 has no human efficacy yet and PTK7 ADCs have failed before; $283M cap is ~12x $23M weighted peak (5.9% x $390M), w $170M cash and first data due 1H 2027.
pit.APLM: ORR of 64.5% (85.7% at GCN>=4) is competitive w capmatinib's ~68% and drug is China-approved, but $3M cash (CEO lent $2M) puts financing ahead of H1 2027 US IND.
pit.IMCR: Q3 Kimmtrak sales of $102.2M (YTD $324.8M) and $901M cash vs $403M debt underpin a $1.5B cap; upside rests on TEBE-AM OS (Q2 2027) and brenetafusp breaking uveal ceiling.
pit.DRTS: ReSTART (n=88, single-arm) has not reported efficacy, yet stock carries $1.2B vs $105M cash and 7 quarters of runway; even a good readout has little room, a stumble has plenty of downside.
pit.ANL: AN9025 no efficacy data, first data 1H27; $646M cap 2.8x cash.
pit.PBLS: Zolucatetide hit 72.2% ORR (13/18) at 32 weeks w no AE discontinuations, and FDA aligned on Ph3. But $3.6B is 3.3x cash and 4.7x weighted peak, and PEDESTAL reads out only in 2029.
pit.RCKT: A $241M cap is 0.9x cash, so market ascribes little to Danon gene therapy RP-A501 despite FDA alignment on a pivotal Ph2 (success = 7/12); topline mid-2028, and a past clinical hold and AAV safety remain overhang.
pit.DMAC: ReMEDy2 has no topline; Q1 2027 DSMB interim may only re-size trial (300-728 pts), which would need more money than $35M cash w ~4 quarters runway, against a $449M cap at 3.8x weighted peak (13% x $900M).
pit.HUMA: Approved w Q3 Symvess sales of only $1.0M, but three positive Ph3s and a Nov-30 dialysis sBLA filing target; $150M cap is ~0.3x $540M weighted peak against $65M cash and $37M debt, so dilution risk is high.
pit.KRYS: VYJUVEK sales are $127.3M (+30%, up from $119.2M) w $1.2B cash, yet $8.8B cap is 7.5x our $1.18B weighted peak; KB111 interim by YE26 and a rare DEB population limit room.
pit.VRCA: VP-315 posted 97% ORR and 51% complete histologic clearance in BCC Ph2, w FDA agreeing a two-trial Ph3. A $68M cap is 17% of $396M weighted peak, but $14M cash vs $12M debt makes dilution gate.
pit.EYPT: LUGANO missed and LUCIA is do-or-die w AXPAXLI ahead, so at ~2.6 quarters of runway cash gets burned before it can be returned, even at 7x $31M cap after a 97% collapse.
pit.SRZN: SZN-8141 has dosed its first DME patient w no efficacy data, and Ph1b reads in 2H 2027 while AXPAXLI, DURAVYU, 4D-150 and Zenkuda advance; $616M cap is 4.4x weighted peak despite $100M cash.
pit.PTN: Going-concern doubt on $7.5M cash against a $10M cap, preclinical MC4R programs and Rhythm's IMCIVREE years ahead: dilution arrives before any Ph1 start.
pit.IRWD: FDA wanted a second Ph3 (STARS-2, 2028, filing 2029) after STARS hit; w $133M quarterly revenue but $325M debt, $803M cap is ~1.9x our $420M weighted peak, little left unpriced.
pit.BCRX: ORLADEYO guided to $625-645M for FY26 (~3x on $1.9B cap) and $180M last quarter; navenibart Ph3 reads out Q3 2027. $375M cash against $817M debt and injectable/CRISPR rivals temper it.
pit.TRAX: ANB033 beat placebo on VH:CrD (+0.49, p=0.009) in a small Ph1b, yet FB102 shares target w Ph2 data a year earlier; $2.0B cap vs $156M cash and 5.7 quarters of runway looks stretched.
pit.ODTX: OD-001 posted 27% remission (20 mg BID, n=41) and 61% response w no SAEs, but no placebo arm; cap is ~2.4x cash and randomized Ph2b data are not due until 2H 2027.
pit.IPSC: An IND is a paper milestone: CNTY-813 has no human data until 2H 2027 while Vertex is dosing and SANA files on a similar timeline, so a $338M cap is 3.2x $106M weighted peak even w $174M of cash.
pit.VERA: Accelerated approval Jul 2026, then final ORIGIN 3 data (HR 0.24, eGFR -0.1 vs -5.7); full-approval sBLA filed Nov 3 for mid-2027. ~$1.9B cap vs $384M cash, 3.8 quarters, against Fabhalta, Filspari and Vertex's povetacicept.
pit.CLYM: At 200 mg, 70% mean PLA2R reduction and 5/13 remissions are promising, yet open-label, small and uncontrolled against rituximab; $788M cap is ~6x $130M weighted peak, so wait for 1000 mg cohort in 2027.
pit.ANNX: Single-infusion tanruprubart improved EQ-VAS at week 1 (p=0.0089) in Ph3 n=241; EU MAA is under review and US BLA is guided Q4 2026. $788M cap vs $213M cash, 4.4 quarters; IVIG generics are SoC.
pit.COGT: GIST PDUFA Nov 30, NonAdvSM Dec 30, AdvSM Jun 2027 after three positive Ph3s (SUMMIT p=0.0002); a $5.2B cap already assumes a successful launch against Sanofi's Ayvakit.
pit.PRQR: First clinical validation of Axiomer RNA editing (dose-dependent bile acid changes in healthy volunteers) is real, but no patient efficacy until mid-2027 Ph2; cash is 71% of $169M cap.
pit.MESO: Ryoncil FY2026 net revenue of $115.2M (net loss $57.5M) is real, but a $1.6B cap is ~14x sales and ~1.8x our $900M peak. Revascor LVAD BLA and mid-2027 low-back-pain Ph3 readout are swing factors; MSC efficacy remains contested.
pit.TTRX: Interim EASI-90 of 44.4% vs 30.4% (n=50) was encouraging, but Stage-2 expansion to ~120-135 patients raises bar, and cash position forces dilution risk before or after data.
pit.ALMS: Two positive Ph3s (PASI90 68.0%/62.1% at wk24 vs apremilast) and a Q4 2026 NDA sit behind a $665M cap, ~0.5x our $1.4B weighted peak, after Sep 1 SLE miss cut stock 57%. Sotyktu is bar and there is no head-to-head; cash is $431M.
pit.FATE: The market ascribes ~$20M ($159M cap less $139M cash) to FT819, now in potentially registrational RECLAIM-LN trial; catch is Kyverna's lead and ~5 quarters of runway.
pit.SCYX: BREXAFEMME royalties are negligible ($0.2M license revenue in Q2) and MARIO Ph3 was terminated, so $71M cash at 2x $34M cap is cheap for a reason until early assets read out.
pit.CRMD: Q2'26 revenue was $101.9M (DefenCath $66.1M, Melinta $35.8M) vs a $383M cap and $355M cash; REZZAYO sNDA action in Q1 2027 adds a catalyst, while DefenCath concentration and $145M debt cap re-rating.
pit.DTIL: First paired-biopsy evidence of cccDNA inactivation, 47-69% HBsAg cuts and no DLTs through 0.8 mg/kg, yet $215M cap is 2x ~$109M weighted peak against $82M cash.
pit.TVGN: Financing and listing risk swamp any Long COVID pivot: $1M of cash on a $37M cap, a Nasdaq compliance notice and n=12 uncontrolled Ph1 data.
pit.VXRT: Pill norovirus vaccine shows GI.1 antibodies +141% and GII.4 +94% in Ph1, but immunogenicity is not protection and Moderna is ~1-2 years ahead in Ph3; $88M cap is 2x $44M weighted peak.
pit.BEAM: BEAM-302 lifted total AAT to 12.4 uM at 60mg (29 patients, no SAEs) and is in pivotal dosing; risto-cel BLA could come by YE26. $2.3B cap is ~0.4x our $5.4B weighted peak, w ~9.6 quarters of cash.
pit.SION: Trading at 0.6x cash after SION-719 flatlined on sweat chloride (-1.0 mmol/L, p=0.7), stock offers a cash floor, but SION-451+2222 is Ph1-only and its 28-day Ph2 starts Q1 2027 against Vertex.
pit.SVRA: Molgramostim PDUFA is Nov 22 (Priority Review, no AdCom) after a hit IMPALA-2 Ph3. $1.2B cap is ~2.6x $455M peak estimate, $130M cash is 3.7 quarters, and aPAP market is small.
pit.AMPH: BAQSIMI revenue of $58.8M (+10%) is about 28% of $208M quarter, w Lilly and Xeris competing, rebate/340B pricing pressure and an open warning letter; $1.2B cap carries $613M of debt.
pit.ASND: YORVIPATH grew 103% to EUR291M and 2026 operating cash flow is guided to at least EUR600M, yet $18B cap is ~5.9x our $3.0B peak and YUVIWEL faces entrenched Voxzogo; EC decision (Q4) is minor.
pit.PLYX: SOTERIA basket trial has Fast Track but only one US site active and no patient dosed; an $83M cap is ~10x $8M cash, 2.7 quarters of runway, so dilution precedes any single-arm data.
pit.MBX: Canvuparatide showed 63% vs 31% responders at wk12 but trails YORVIPATH by 1-2 years; a $2.6B cap is 1.8x $1.5B weighted peak, w $482M cash and MBX 4291 obesity data in Q4.
pit.IVA: All 1,009 main-cohort pts finished 72 weeks; topline Q4 2026, funded through it ($272M cash). Ph2b fibrosis 48% vs 23%; cap is 0.6x $1.9B weighted peak vs Rezdiffra's lead.
pit.KLRA: Fully enrolled 5,000-pt KaiNETIC Ph3 reads out mid-2028, w oral ribupatide Ph3 start 1H27; $1.04B cash is 64% of cap. Tirzepatide and Structure's oral GLP-1 (16.3%) are ahead on proof.
pit.RANI: RaniPill delivered >150% of SC bioavailability in 30 volunteers, yet efficacy is unproven against Rybelsus and orforglipron; $75M cap vs ~$164M probability-weighted peak, w 5.6 quarters of runway and Nasdaq bid risk near $1.
pit.SRPT: Net product revenue was $323.8M in Q3 (PMO $240.3M, Elevidys $83.5M); $1.6B cap is ~1.3x annualized sales and cash of $999M exceeds $857M debt. Safety deaths and ambulatory-only label cap it; a label regain would be upside.
pit.BNTC: BB-301 hit 6/6 low-dose responders at 12 months and 3/3 at high dose w no SAEs in a disease w no approved gene therapy. $176M cash is 42% of $423M cap; FDA pivotal design is due 1Q27, start mid-2027, so it is a small-n bet.
pit.RAPP: RAP-219 FOCUS 1/2 Ph3 enrolling, runway through 2029 on ~$815M pro forma cash vs a $1.4B cap; a positive mania Ph2 adds a second shot, though 72% seizure reduction came from an open-label n=27.
pit.FLNA: Repurposed Cassava drug w mouse-only TSC data is a value trap; lifting clinical hold does not create a human signal, even w cash ($51M) at 2.2x $23M cap.
pit.ALKS: Takeda's ORZEYFUL was approved Aug 5, so alixorexton (Ph3 topline from mid-2027) is a follower: ~$1.5B weighted peak (62% x $2.4B) versus an $8.2B cap supported by ~$480M of quarterly revenue.
pit.ABOS: ALTITUDE-AD, a 542-patient Ph2, reads out in late 2026 for a lower-ARIA anti-amyloid backed only by Ph1 plaque reduction of 20-25%; $79M cash w 2.9 quarters of runway makes this a binary.
pit.CGTX: SHIMMER (n=130) met safety but NPI-12 slowing of 86% missed significance (p=0.0545); FDA aligned on Ph3 endpoints, no start date, neflamapimod is ahead, cash $32M vs a $61M cap.
pit.GANX: Uncontrolled Ph1b biomarker data (n=21) and 2.9 quarters of cash against a Ph2 that slipped to 1Q27 and is unfunded; IND clearance is real, but next event is a raise.
pit.OKYO: Urcosimod has no approved NCP competitor and Ph2a showed VAS -5.5 vs -2.75, yet only 6 vs 6 patients; NEPTUNE Ph3 started Oct 2026, w $21M cash vs a $62M cap, so a raise is likely.
pit.NTRB: AVERSA fentanyl is preclinical w pivotal HAP study not yet started and no efficacy data; $71M cap is ~3x 15% x $153M weighted peak, against $3M cash and ~6 quarters of runway.
pit.DFTX: DT120 has three positive Ph3s (GAD HAM-A -5.4 and -5.1, MDD MADRS -8.1), Breakthrough in MDD, and ~$1.05B cash into 2030; NDA is 1H 2027, yet $4.1B cap is 1.4x our $3.0B peak.
pit.HELP: Ph3 APPROACH hit at wk 6 (MADRS -7.6 vs placebo, remission 50.9% vs 18.2%, n=222) w Breakthrough status; $583M cap sits against $171M cash, and EMBRACE reads 4Q 2027.
pit.NERV: Roluperidone's confirmatory Ph3 (~380 pts, Part A 2H 2027) follows a prior FDA rejection; $166M cap vs $77M cash and $60M debt, w 0.6 quarters of runway forcing a raise first.
pit.APMD: First oral OSA combo w positive SynAIRgy (n=646) and LunAIRo Ph3s, PDUFA Feb 28 2027; $678M cap (cash $352M) is 0.2x weighted peak, w dry mouth, insomnia and coverage open issues.
pit.VOGX: Gut-restricted SGLT1 inhibitor w 2 completed Ph2s in PBH and $82M of cash (cap is 2.6x cash), but EMERGE Ph2b topline is 2H 2027 and Amylyx's avexitide is ahead.
pit.TLPH: 70-patient CRRT Ph3, 75% enrolled, is entire story, and thin cash looks tight to finish it; a $53M cap vs $150M probability-weighted peak is tempting but financing comes first.
pit.HROW: Revenue of $99.3M in Q3 and a reaffirmed $350-365M guide show VEVYE working (+75%), but $293M of debt vs $75M of cash and a crowded dry-eye field keep $1.1B cap fairly priced.
pit.WWB: Interim POLARIS-1 shows FEV1 up to +267 mL (p=0.033, n=147, no head-to-head vs Tezspire). $1.0B cap is ~1.7x $600M weighted peak; week-24 primary 1H27, Ph3 topline not until 1H29.
pit.AGIO: Cash of $907M covers half $1.8B cap, w approved PKD/thalassemia sales of $55M a quarter. SCD (PDUFA Feb 1, 2027, extended over REMS) had Hb response 40.6% vs 2.9% but no pain-crisis win; Novo's etavopivat follows.
pit.CLLS: Pivoted Sep 2026 to in vivo editing, exiting lasme-cel and eti-cel; APOC3 editor cut TG ~76% in mice, human data 2H 2027. Cash tops $105M cap; $77M debt.
pit.ATRA: Tab-cel is EU-approved w ~50% ORR in EBV+ PTLD and a US BLA resubmission accepted; but cash of $9.9M, runway into mid-2027 and going-concern risk leave a 1.2x-peak-estimate cap a coin flip.
pit.SLS: REGAL hit OS (24.0 vs 14.7 mo, HR 0.59, p=0.035, n=126); $3.9B cap is ~8x our $500M peak; $135M cash (9/30) predates a proposed $150M offering; one trial before a 1H27 BLA.
pit.LEGN: A ~$2.8B run-rate, 373 sites and $853M cash against a $3.1B cap look cheap for best-selling myeloma CAR-T; early deaths in CARTITUDE-4 and CEO turnover explain gap.
pit.CCCC: Ph1 showed 53% ORR at RP2D after 7 median priors, durable; elranatamab combo data mid-2027, MOMENTUM ORR 2H27. Cash is 76% of $361M cap, but BMS CELMoDs set bar.
pit.ATNM: ATNM-400 is a preclinical Ac-225 prostate asset w no human data facing entrenched Pluvicto, and market gives it little ($52M cap vs $42M cash); wait for IND.
pit.CMPX: Trading below cash ($163M vs $119M cap) after Sep 22 FDA call for an OS trial; randomized win (ORR 18.0% vs 5.3%, PFS 4.7 vs 2.6 mo) is ignored, though OS missed on 54% crossover.
pit.ONCY: ~30% ORR vs ~14% historical in anal cancer and FDA alignment on a pivotal are real, but $5M cash against $55M cap makes financing first event; high-risk, funding-gated.
pit.EXEL: The $16B cap is ~4.5x our $3.6B weighted peak for zanzalintinib, whose mCRC OS gain is modest (HR 0.80) against regorafenib, Lonsurf combo and fruquintinib; Mar 3, 2027 PDUFA is largely priced.
pit.CGON: PIVOT-006 Ph3 cut recurrence 68% (HR 0.32, no Gr3+ TRAEs) and SUO is Dec 2, yet $7.1B cap is 2.6x our $2.7B peak; BLA is not complete until March 2027.
pit.ENGN: A $132M cap vs $266M cash (debt $33M) discounts weak durability (~25% at 12 mo) vs cretostimogene and Anktiva; 56% any-time CR and a Q4 2026 BLA start give cash-backed upside.
pit.CADL: Ph3 in prostate (n=745) cut recurrence or death 30% (HR 0.70, p=0.0155; 38-39% on cancer-specific DFS); SPA, RMAT, Fast Track; BLA slipped to mid-2027; $450M cap vs $203M cash.
pit.ARVN: Trading at 0.8x cash w no debt, and ARV-102 shows >50% LRRK2 knockdown sustained 28 days; clinical benefit is unproven, Denali's LRRK2 inhibitor is further along, and US IND is on hold.
pit.LONA: ELAINE-1 missed significance (HR 0.70, p=0.14) and thin runway means a raise first, but w $33M cap below its $51M cash into a 2H27 Ph3 it is a cash-backed option on ~13mo combo mPFS.
pit.CGEN: MAIA-ovarian (62 pts, 2:1 vs placebo) reads out by end of Q1 2027; $118M cash covers 61% of $193M cap, so downside looks cushioned, but we put PoS at 11% and wait for data.
pit.FTH: PIK-201 Ph2 showed 33% confirmed ORR (12/36; 44% in PIK3CA-mutant), 7.4 mo mPFS and 64% Gr3+ TRAEs, single-arm; $175M cash vs a $241M cap gives support while Ph3 design awaits FDA.
pit.PDSB: A 71% ORR and 80% 24-mo survival in a small NCI-run MSS CRC Ph2 is unconfirmed; w $15M cash (about 3.6 quarters) vs a $67M cap and an up-to-$22.3M PIPE (only ~$11.3M closed, rest tied to the Ph3 protocol), wait for filing.
pit.BBOT: BBO-8520 shows 63% ORR in G12C-naive (n=41) and 75% w pembrolizumab in G12C-experienced patients (n=17), yet $315M cash is 2x $159M cap; n and follow-up trail Amgen, BMS and Roche.
pit.BDTX: Market cap of $88M sits below $102M cash while silevertinib shows 60% ORR, 15.0-mo mPFS and 86% CNS ORR (n=43 at 200mg); 150mg data are unreported and firmonertinib's 16-mo mPFS is bar.
pit.ZLAB: Zoci's 1L SCLC Ph1 (ORR 81.8%, n=33) is strong, but $2.6B also capitalizes a $108M-a-quarter China business; tarlatamab sets bar, and DLLEVATE interim is 2H27, so patience is warranted.
pit.IOVA: Q3 revenue of $122M (+80% YoY, ~60% gross margin) and a HLA-unrestricted label back a $3.5B cap; cash is $382M, so NSCLC sBLA (2027) and ex-US approvals must extend ramp.
pit.NTHI: NEO100's 48.9% 6-month PFS vs a 20% benchmark (n=24, single-arm) is encouraging, but $2M cash and ~0.4 quarters of runway put dilution ahead of FDA meeting; $113M is 2.8x $40M peak estimate.
pit.IMNM: RINGSIDE (n=156) cut progression risk 84% and hit every key endpoint; PDUFA is Apr 28, 2027 and EMA has validated MAA. Nirogacestat is incumbent, and $462M cash vs a $2.0B cap funds launch into 2028.
pit.MIST: At $52M vs $145M cash (and $143M debt), market prices CARDAMYST's launch as a failure: Q3 sales $1.0M, +73% q/q, w free off-label propafenone habit to beat; Q3 net loss was $25.8M.
pit.LRMR: BLA submitted Nov 16 (acceptance early 2027, approval targeted mid-2027) on a surrogate; $329M cap is near ~$328M weighted peak, while $129M cash and 4.7 quarters of runway force a raise.
pit.LQDA: Q3 YUTREPIA sales $222.7M (+31% q/q) w $140.5M adj. EBITDA, yet a $5.0B cap is 2.4x $2.1B peak estimate while '327 remedy and appeal could cut PH-ILD and Tyvaso DPI holds share.
pit.PVLA: Approval at 97% PoS looks near-certain (SELVA n=49, 2.13-pt IGA gain, p<0.001), but $2.3B cap is 1.5x $1.6B peak and QTORIN must justify orphan pricing against ~$100/yr generic sirolimus.
pit.ABEO: Q3 ZEVASKYN sales of $13.5M (+18% q/q, 15 treatments since launch, 8 QTCs) against a $161M cap that is 1.2x cash; surgical-graft logistics and Krystal's convenient VYJUVEK limit ramp.
pit.PTHS: ZELSUVMI revenue of $15.4M (+45% QoQ) against $28M cap, ~0.1x $345M peak estimate; w $32M cash and $30M drawn on its credit facility, capital structure is whole debate.
pit.FDMT: 4D-150 cut aflibercept injections 78% over two years (n=45), and $863M cap is 0.4x our $2.1B weighted peak; w $375M of cash and 6.7 quarters, financing could arrive before 4FRONT-1 readout.
pit.BLTE: First-ever Stargardt candidate (36% lesion-growth cut, p=0.0033) has priority review and a Feb 12 2027 PDUFA, but $6.6B vs a $1.2B weighted peak means PHOENIX in geographic atrophy carries value.
pit.ALDX: Three CRLs on field-trial reproducibility and no resubmission date make cash only real asset ($65M, 1.8x $36M cap); avoid until FDA dispute resolves.
pit.SPRY: Q2 neffy revenue $26.2M, ~5% share, but no new formulary wins; $361M cap is ~1.0x our $365M weighted peak, w $138M cash vs $197M debt and CSU Ph2b interim (Q1 2027) as offset.
pit.NTLA: Ph3 HAELO hit and BLA has priority review (PDUFA Mar 10 2027, no adcom): $1.4B cap is 0.4x our $3.6B weighted peak, though $615M cash must carry a launch vs monthly injectables.
pit.AGMB: Market cap $294M vs $288M cash (16.9 quarters runway) buys an oral GI-restricted ALK5 inhibitor entering ~320-pt Ph2b w FDA Fast Track; efficacy in strictures is unproven and no readout is guided.
pit.PALI: Gut-restricted PDE4 PALI-2108 has cash ($114M, 14.6 quarters) to reach Q4 2027 Ph2b readout in ~204 UC pts; cap is ~0.5x weighted peak, though signal so far is n=5 open-label.
pit.VTVT: CATT1 is fully enrolled w 166 randomized and topline mid-2027; a $220M cap is ~0.2x $1.1B weighted peak (45% PoS x $2.4B), cash of $77M runs 18.6 quarters, so readout is a binary w asymmetric payoff.
pit.JBIO: JADE101 shows ~70% IgA reduction in 32 healthy volunteers, but no patient data until JUNIPER interim in Q2 2027 and atacicept is approved; $1.3B cap is 4.9x $264M weighted peak despite $476M cash.
pit.GENB: Golukibart has Ph1 biomarker data (n=96) but no exacerbation data; Ph3 SOLAIRIA-1/2 topline 2H 2027. $1.4B cap is ~1.9x our $700M weighted peak, w $404M cash and Tezspire approved as bar.
pit.RNAC: AURORA Ph3 gMG topline Q1 2027 on an SPA-agreed design; $208M cap vs $123M cash (5.2 quarters) is ~15% of $1.4B weighted peak. Retreatment gave -6.6 MG-ADL at month 12, but only 5 patients.

pit.MGX: Preclinical in vivo hem-A editor w monkey-only data faces Novo's SC prophylaxis first; $140M cash is 5x $28M cap, but value trap until human FVIII data.
pit.GMAB: Up 102% in six months to a $33.4B cap, ~9x $3.6B peak estimate; Rina-S's 45.9% ORR in open-label Ph1/2 is good, but pipeline wins already look capitalized.
pit.CRVS: Soquelitinib's Ph1 AD data (EASI -72% vs -40% placebo, n=72) are strong, but registrational asset is a ~150-patient PTCL Ph3 w a Q1 2027 futility analysis. A $982M cap is ~6x our $165M weighted peak against $203M cash.
pit.OMER: Q3 net sales of $35.9M (+26% vs $28.5M in Q2) and $4.7M non-GAAP net income show a working launch, but EU CHMP negative stands and a $1.2B cap is ~3.3x our $375M peak estimate; a Jan 1 2027 340B reimbursement change is next catalyst.
pit.XCUR: Burixafor met its mobilization primary (89%), but a $6M cap, $3M cash, going-concern doubt and a Nasdaq equity deficiency make survival, not a supportive-care niche, issue.
pit.ELVN: ENABLE-2 Ph3 (n~450 vs TKI) starts before YE26 after 54% MMR in 161 patients; w $884M cash cap still carries ~$2.7B above it, against Scemblix and generics.
pit.CTMX: At $434M market pays ~$86M net of $348M cash for CX-2051: 32% cORR, 7.1 mo mPFS, 88% DCR (n=56, 10mg/kg) in 3L+ CRC. Needs randomized confirmation; Jan 2027 update sets dose and registrational plan.
pit.ZYME: Ziihera 1L GEA approval (OS HR 0.65) triggered a $250M milestone (received Oct); $1.8B cap is 4.6x our $400M peak vs ~$350M pro forma cash and $600M non-recourse notes.
pit.ACTU: Randomized 1L pancreatic survival win (HR 0.62, n=233) at a $7M cap, but $4M cash and a going-concern warning make dilution real event; a high-risk lottery ticket.
pit.TNGX: Vopimetostat plus daraxonrasib ORR 82% (18/22), 9-mo PFS 88%, but 40% Gr3 TRAEs and a small sample; BMS, Amgen and AZ chase PRMT5, and a Ph3 only starts 1H 2027 at a $4.1B cap.
pit.URGN: Revenue of $68.0M (+35% QoQ, 1,538 sites) and a PDUFA on Jun 14, 2027 argue for upside at a $1.4B cap, 1.8x $800M peak estimate; thin cash ($91M, $189M debt) is risk.
pit.XNCR: XmAb819 shows 45.5% confirmed ORR (n=11) w 72.1% Gr3+ related AEs, behind Merck's 52.6%; $2.7B cap is ~12x our $225M weighted peak and registration work starts only by end 2027.
pit.RADX: RAD101 met its Ph2b endpoint (93% MRI concordance, n=30) and FDA aligned on a ~280-pt Ph3, but cash is $4M w ~1.3 quarters of runway, and $3.3B is ~124x $27M peak estimate.
pit.ALXO: Evorpacept plus HER2 antibodies hit 65.0% ORR vs 26.1% in CD47-high gastric (n=43); cap of $138M is below $153M cash, funded to 1H 2028, w ASPEN-09-Breast topline 2H 2027.
pit.CORT: Lifyorli $91.4M in Q3 on ROSELLA (mOS 16.0 vs 11.9 mo, HR 0.65); Korlym plus authorized generic +19% q/q to $249M; Cushing's PDUFA Dec 17; $8.7B cap is 2.9x our peak.
pit.GNLX: OnPrime topline is due by year-end, but $10M cash is 11% of $92M cap, oncolytic viruses have an uneven record and mirvetuximab holds FRa+ lane; cap exceeds our ~$71M weighted peak.
pit.BCAX: Ficerafusp alfa shows 48-54% cORR and 21.3-mo mOS vs pembrolizumab's 19% ORR, and $442M cash covers 66% of $669M cap, but it is single-arm; FORTIFI-HN01 interim topline mid-2027 is proof.
pit.SMMT: The FDA CRL cites no significant OS benefit (HR 0.79, 95% CI 0.62-1.01) despite PFS HR 0.52; $9.8B is 2.3x our $4.2B peak and 15.6x $630M cash, resting on undated HARMONi-3 and -7.
pit.NVCT: A China-approved oral factor B inhibitor w 94.6% vs 69.4% transfusion-free over eculizumab; stock has nearly tripled in 12 months, and US IND by YE26 must show differentiation from Fabhalta.
pit.MAIA: THIO-101 Part C: 88% DCR (38/43) in 3L+ NSCLC; 27.5% x $560M is ~$154M vs a $61M cap, w Ph3 THIO-104 interim survival in 2027, though $21M cash needs to be raised first.
pit.MOLN: MP0712 cleared dose level 1 w no DLTs and dose level 2 is fully dosing; $103M cap is ~4x ~$27M weighted peak (10.6% x $250M), so efficacy in 2027 is what matters.
pit.EVAX: 75% ORR (n=16) w 92% still responding at 2 years is cheap option value against a $25M cap mostly backed by $18M cash, but a tiny n and Merck/Moderna's mRNA-4157 lead cap conviction.
pit.IDYA: OptimUM-02 (n=313) showed mPFS 6.9 vs 3.1 months, HR 0.42, and NDA is under RTOR; yet $3.1B vs $1.15B cash prices platform value beyond a small uveal market, so we wait.
pit.OSTX: Rolling BLA on ~40 single-arm patients (3-yr OS 71.2%) w ~$1M cash and 0.1 quarter of runway; $35M cap is ~2.3x ~$15M weighted peak (20% x $75M), so avoid.
pit.BBIO: Attruby Q3 revenue of $253.2M (+~$145M y/y) is a real launch, but a $15B cap is 2.4x $6.4B peak estimate; three Priority Review PDUFAs (Nov 27, Feb 4, May 8) follow, w tafamidis holding share.
pit.TNYA: NYHA improved >=1 class in 5/6 patients and EMA PRIME was granted, yet n=6 and AAV durability risk, $67M cash and 3.9 quarters of runway mean financing follows year-end 2026 pivotal-design update.
pit.TENX: After failed LEVEL Ph3 (n=241, p=0.63), case rests on a nominal subgroup (+26.3m, p=0.011, n=119) and an FDA Type C outcome in Q1 2027; $85M cap vs $114M cash does not make up for that.
pit.MANE: Study 302 gave +43.9 hairs/cm2 at 12 months (BID) w no treatment-related SAEs, yet $5.3B cap is 2.5x our $2.1B weighted peak, and branded pricing must beat ~$15/month generic minoxidil.
pit.DERM: Emrosi revenue is $9.0M (+84% YoY) in Q3 on ~40k scripts, and $104M cap is 0.35x $300M peak estimate; ramp must outrun going-concern doubt and Oracea's formulary position.
pit.EOLS: Revenue grew 13% to $78.0M w $1.2M adj. EBITDA, FY guide $330-337M, and Sculpt approval due Q4; $439M cap is 1.2x our $360M peak, but Botox's ~70% share caps upside.
pit.OTLK: LYTENAVA won approval in Jul 2026 w ~12-year exclusivity, but runway is about 1 quarter ($11M cash, $18M debt, $97M cap) and payers still have off-label Avastin, so we avoid.
pit.IRD: LCA5 registrational Ph3 (8 pts) starts dosing Q4 2026 and BEST1 BIRD-1 reads Q1 2027; $387M cap is 1.7x our $231M weighted peak w $89M cash against $35M of debt, so balance is fair.
pit.PHAT: Q3 VOQUEZNA sales $84.7M (+71% YoY), second straight positive operating cash flow quarter, guidance $310-325M; $499M cap is ~1.5x that, w EoE Ph2 topline and an exclusivity ruling due.
pit.AQST: Resubmitted after a Jan CRL on human factors; PDUFA Mar 16 2027 at ~59% PoS. Yet $473M cap is 5.7x our $83M weighted peak, w $90M cash vs $51M debt and neffy ahead on market.
pit.SEPN: SEP-479 is in healthy-volunteer Ph1 w data Q1 2027 and its first PTH1R candidate was dropped; a $2.0B cap is 7x $270M weighted peak, w $565M cash and a 70% 12-month run.
pit.EPRX: RESOLVE Ph2b is fully enrolled (120 pts vs placebo) w interim data in Dec; Ph1b/2a showed 66% remission at 36 weeks, but open-label and a $565M cap near ~1.7x weighted peak leave little cushion.
pit.VRDN: Approved LUMVOA did $24.7M in its first quarter and elegrobart (SC) files Q1 2027, w $955M cash against $364M debt; $3.7B cap is 1.8x $2.1B peak estimate, so convenience over Tepezza must carry it.
pit.MGTX: Bota-vec re-acquired from J&J; EMA MAA Dec 2026, BLA Q1 2027, w $187M cash against $122M debt. A cap 3.7x ~$229M weighted peak leaves little room, so we wait for filings.
pit.NKTX: Myositis 5/6 and SSc 5/7 responses are early and small; $93M cap is 0.4x its $216M cash, but 7.9 quarters of runway and CAR-T rivals like Adicet's prula-cel mean cash alone is not case.
pit.CNTB: COPD Ph2 hit (81% fewer treatment failures, p=0.0122) but asthma missed, and a $45M cap on $44M cash w 2.9 quarters of runway means dilution before any Ph3. Avoid.
pit.TGTX: Q3 US BRIUMVI revenue $232.6M (+52%) and FY26 guidance raised to ~$1B, but $8.8B is ~9.7x our $910M peak estimate. SubQ Ph3 topline lands YE2026/early 2027 as ocrelizumab biosimilars enter.
pit.KNSA: Q3 ARCALYST revenue of $286.0M (+58%) and a raised $1.045-1.050B guide are excellent, yet an $8.0B cap is ~7.6x guidance, and Cardiol's Ph3 plus KPL-387 timing (2H27) cap multiple.
pit.ADMA: Q3 revenue grew only 5% to $141.1M as ASCENIV rose 31% and BIVIGAM slid to $15.4M; guidance of at least $530M puts $3.0B cap near 5.6x, so next print needs to hold margins (71%).
pit.KYMR: BROADEN2 Ph2b (~200 AD patients, 16 weeks, 3 doses) reads by year-end; w $1.6B cash against a $13B cap, stock needs a clean dupilumab-class result, and misses are not covered.
pit.ZURA: Cash is ~1.4x $136M cap w TibuSHIELD topline due Dec 15; bar is bimekizumab in HS, but runway of 9.5 quarters means a miss costs little relative to cash backing.
pit.XBIT: A $56M cap vs $105M cash is a discount for a reason: vilamakitug has zero clinical efficacy data in axSpA, trails approved IL-17 agents, and 150-pt V-SPINE Ph2 is only test.
pit.ANAB: Jemperli net sales hit $365M (+20% YoY) and rectal cancer was approved in Oct, so $1.4B cap sits well under our $1.5B peak estimate; Tesaro royalty litigation and $257M debt vs $164M cash are risks.
pit.SPRO: Cash of $108M is ~2x $55M cap, w $103M debt netting that to ~$5M; UTEBZI is approved (GSK-run, $25M milestone received) and SP001 Ph2 in IgG4-RD starts ~Q2 2027.
pit.VIR: Ph3 ECLIPSE 1 (n=124) hit 44% vs 0% on undetectable HDV RNA w ALT normalization; $898M cash is 58% of a $1.5B cap, ECLIPSE 2/3 data Q1 2027, FDA filing mid-2027, one Grade 3 related AE.
pit.NVAX: Pivot to Matrix-M royalties (high-teens to low-20s % from Sanofi, Pfizer license) has worked, but a $1.3B cap is ~3.9x $338M weighted peak; $75M Sanofi milestone due mid-2027.
pit.ASMB: Assembly holds a 40% US cost/profit share and just received a $75M Gilead fee; ~$150M of implied value ($464M cap, $314M cash) awaits Gilead's Ph2 start by end 2026 and Ph2 data.
pit.UNCY: The resubmission was accepted Oct 21 2026 after a CRL citing only manufacturing; PDUFA is ~Mar 25 2027, w $61M cash (8.9 quarters) vs a $103M cap, 0.36x our $288M weighted peak.
pit.EDSA: Positive Ph3 ARDS mortality result (24% vs 33%, p<0.001, n=278) at a $28M cap below $33M cash after an 88% drop; open question is whether FDA accepts it or demands a confirmatory trial.
pit.AVLN: AP01 is inhaled pirfenidone, same molecule as generic oral; $1.3B cap (cash $387M) is 5.1x our weighted peak ahead of MIST Ph2b FVC in 2H2027, while PureTech's Ph3 is already dosing.
pit.AARD: Full cardiac clinical hold and a terminated HERO Ph3 leave no live program, and VYKAT already owns PWS label; a value trap until a path emerges, despite cash at 3.1x $29M cap.
pit.ARWR: Approved for FCS; SHASTA-3/4 cut TG 79%/81% and pancreatitis events 78%, w sHTG in priority review. Ionis leads by 6-12 months; $6.2B cap is 2.1x $3.0B weighted peak.
pit.DNLI: Avlayah Q3 revenue of $17.8M beat $10-12M guide and Q4 is guided to $30-32M, but LRRK2 Ph2b failure removes upside; $3.4B cap vs $1.0B cash and a $1.2B peak estimate leaves a balanced setup.
pit.AMLX: LUCIDITY Ph3 hit (55% fewer Level 2/3 hypoglycemia events, p=0.000003) and no approved rival is within two years, but $3.6B is 2.8x our $1.26B weighted peak after a 93% 12-month run.
pit.GLUE: GFORCE-1 (n=108) cut NEK7 80-90% and hsCRP 85% w no SAEs, and $578M cash is 62% of $933M cap; yet gout Ph2 data is 2H27, CAD efficacy is unproven and ziltivekimab leads by ~2 years.
pit.EXOZ: Successful 100-liter pilot run is manufacturing progress, not drug development; w a preclinical compound, $6M cash (1.2 quarters) and a $38M cap, dilution is near-certain event.
pit.BIOA: QUELL-CV Ph2 (n~160) reads 12-week hsCRP in Q4 2026 after ~86% Ph1 cuts. Cash is 1.5x cap, cushioning a miss; MACE benefit is unproven and Novo's injectable ziltivekimab leads.
pit.VCEL: Q3 revenue rose 26% to $85.4M (MACI +21%, burn care +52%) and FY26 guidance rose to $344-346M, yet $2.9B cap is ~8.5x that revenue, leaving little for multiple to do before Q1 2027 FY27 guide.
pit.TRDA: Cash of $193M covers 91% of $213M cap, which cushions downside, but Cohort 1 (n=8) moved dystrophin only +2.36% over a 4.00% baseline. Cohort 1 data are due by YE2026 and Cohort 2 (12 mg/kg) in Q1 2027.
pit.SRRK: ISEMBYLD was approved Sep 11 and launch is underway, w EU CHMP opinion in 1H 2027. But a $5.9B cap is ~4.9x our $1.2B peak estimate for an SMA add-on on near-zero revenue so far; obesity optionality is unproven.
pit.OVID: A $519M cap is 1.6x ~$331M weighted peak (28% x $1.2B) for a drug w no efficacy data; cash of $161M gives runway into 2029, so wait for Q1 2027 PPR study and 2H 2027 focal Ph2.
pit.PRTA: Cash of $271M is 66% of $409M cap; prasinezumab Ph3 PARAISO (n~900) completes in 2029 after a narrow PADOVA miss, and Prothena gets only royalties and milestones.
pit.AXSM: Quarterly revenue is $260M and Auvelity peak guidance is $8B after Apr 30 agitation approval, vs a $7.2B cap; solriamfetol Ph3 (1Q27) and AXS-12 PDUFA add legs.
pit.PMN: PRECISE-AD is fully enrolled (144) w zero ARIA-E at 6-month blinded look, while unblinded efficacy has slipped to early 2027; cash of $64M is 2x $32M cap.
pit.QURE: BLA accepted w a May 1 2027 PDUFA on n=12 data vs external control, after FDA reversals; $1.5B cap is ~2.1x our 32% x $2.25B weighted peak, but $768M cash (vs $548M debt) cushions.
pit.ACAD: Nuplazid and Daybue grew Q3 revenue 23% to $342M against FY26 guidance of $1.265-1.295B, so $3.2B cap is ~2.5x sales, w $976M cash; RADIANT missed its primary (p=0.0603) and AD psychosis is a graveyard.
pit.ANIK: FDA deemed Hyalofast PMA not approvable (Oct 2026) and Cingal is ex-US only, w an NDA planned by end-2027 after BE enrollment closed in Sep. Cap $170M vs $45M cash and ~$31M quarterly revenue.
pit.COLL: Q3 product revenue $216.3M (+3%): JORNAY PM +24% to $51.9M, pain portfolio -18% to $138.0M; FY26 guide $825-855M reaffirmed. Cap $828M vs $145M cash and $1.08B debt; debt paydown is lever.
pit.GHRS: Ph2b TRD showed MADRS -15.5 vs placebo at Day 8 (p<0.001) and FDA hold lifted Jan 2026; $1.3B cap is about $1.4B weighted peak, w $351M cash and an end-of-Ph2 meeting in Q1 2027.
pit.LPCN: PPD Ph3 missed its ITT primary and rescue is a post hoc subgroup (n=54) w litigation overhang, so $23M cash at 1.8x $13M cap is cheap for a reason.
pit.EBS: NARCAN is eroding: Q3 revenue -52% to $110M, naloxone -42% to $43.5M, FY26 guide cut to $600-645M. Debt of $514M exceeds $299M cap; $176M cash cushions but does not fix it.
pit.ATTO: Single-dose Ph1b showed CPUO PP-NRS4 82% vs 22% placebo and ~95% IL-31 suppression, w cash at 59% of a $673M cap. Still small-n (AD 18 vs 8), Ph2 only starts 1H 2027 and Nemluvio/Dupixent set bar, so we hold.
pit.MSLE: Open-label grip gains and a 49.7% to 46.0% fat-fraction dip in 4 adults are hook; placebo-controlled BASECAMP Ph2 reads Q1 2027. Cash of $53M is 33% of $159M cap, so funding is needed, and stock is up ~12x in a year.
pit.BNTX: Cash of $18.6B covers 88% of $21B cap, so little is paid for pumitamig, whose seven Ph3 trials have no randomized data yet; 2026 revenue guide was raised to EUR 1.7-1.9B and ivonescimab leads class.
pit.IAM: IAM1363 shows 36% systemic PR (19/53) and 41% intracranial PR (9/22) w 5.9% grade 3 TRAEs, but field is crowded (zongertinib, T-DXd, tucatinib). $208M cash is 74% of $280M cap; shares were below $16 IPO price.
pit.XFOR: WHIM revenue is $2.9M a quarter, so $362M cap (cash $188M, debt $77M) rides on 4WARD (n=126, enrollment done Q4 2026, topline Q1 2028); it is ~0.7x our $486M weighted peak, but cheap G-CSF sets bar.
pit.ALLO: Cema-cel MRD-negativity was 58% vs 17% w RMAT and Fast Track; interim EFS in mid-2027 is binary at 30% PoS, though cash into 2029 funds it and cap is below cash.
pit.IPHA: Lacutamab showed Sezary ORR 43%, mDOR ~26mo, mPFS 8.3mo; TELLOMAK-3 starts Q1 2027 and runway reaches Q1 2028, so cash covers 92% of cap while upside case is thin.
pit.DMRA: No human data until CLARITY-101 proof-of-concept mid-2027; $1.8B cap is 3.4x its $529M cash and ~14x weighted peak. Preclinical 30-fold affinity gain vs Incyte's antibody is pitch.
pit.RIGL: $823M cap is 2.8x annualized sales (~$290M) and 8.3x cash; R289's 33-40% TI in a small Ph1b must top imetelstat/luspatercept (38-40%) to earn a pipeline premium; ASH Dec 2026.
pit.AAPG: Olverembatinib 61% MMR at 2 yrs; NRDL renewed; US edge unproven; $1.2B cap, cash below debt.
pit.BCYC: A $223M cap vs $470M cash prices zelenectide as nearly dead; Duravelo-2 (randomized Ph2, EV+pembro bar of ~31 mo mOS) reads 2H 2027, w nuzefatide PDAC Ph2 as free option.
pit.NBP: Ph1b ORR 75-77% and 82% 6-mo PFS in 1L CLDN18.2 gastric, w FDA-confirmed ORR-based accelerated path and a Ph3 start targeted Q4 2026; $191M cash vs $211M cap, but data are single-arm.
pit.RNXT: Interim mOS 16 vs 10mo (p=0.051) leans positive w enrollment done and topline 2H27, so short carries squeeze risk; $16M peak estimate is still 0.3x $53M cap.
pit.RVMD: Daraxonrasib doubled 2L PDAC survival (OS HR 0.40) and is approved, but $39.9B cap already capitalizes ~6.3x $6.3B peak estimate; 1L data and launch uptake are swing.
pit.AKTS: AKY-1189 (Ac-225 Nectin-4) Ph1b has no efficacy data, vs approved Padcev (since 2019); $899M cap is 2.9x our $306M weighted peak; $493M cash runs into 2029.
pit.TLX: Revenue $245M (+19%); $3.0B cap is 2.5x our $1.2B weighted peak; $252M cash vs $600M debt plus $302M ITM net debt assumed (vote Dec 1); no Part 2 date.
pit.CELC: REVTORPYK cut progression/death 76% (HR ~0.24) and launched Sep 30 w no direct wild-type rival; $643M cash vs $754M debt, and PIK3CA-mutant sNDA is next lever on a $3.3B cap.
pit.OKUR: OnKure reset to preclinical after deprioritizing OKI-219; OKI-345 IND is H1 2027, 1+ year behind zovegalisib (Ph3) and approved PI3K rivals, so 1.2x cash cover does not make this a buy.
pit.VSTM: VS-7375 (KRAS G12D) 41% cORR in 2L+ PDAC, 1L Ph3 start YE26; LGSOC launch $24M Q3; $1.3B cap.
pit.ANIX: No confirmed RECIST responses after 14 CAR-T patients over four years, TNBC vaccine Ph2 undated, and $14M cash against an $89M cap; dilution looks near-certain and our PoS is 6%.
pit.CHRS: Cap of $82M is level w $84M cash and Loqtorzi earned $14.0M in Q3 (OS HR 0.62), but $53M debt, 2.5 quarters of runway and a ~3,000-patient US NPC market make casdozokitug HCC data in 1H27 swing.
pit.NUVB: A best-in-class ROS1 TKI w Q3 sales of $27.5M (+18% QoQ) and 49.7mo mDOR, yet $1.4B cap is ~3.5x $385M peak and $454M debt offsets much of $663M cash; wait for a better entry.
pit.STRO: STRO-004 shows partial responses in three tumor types (n=49) but discloses no ORR or PFS, while Tivdak is approved; $249M debt offsets $142M cash against a $155M cap, w data in 1H 2027.
pit.LTRN: $6M cap against $6M cash buys an FDA-aligned single-arm L858R study (8.3mo mPFS vs 3-5mo for chemo), but ~2 quarters of runway makes dilution near-certain; option value only.
pit.IMMP: After NSCLC Ph3 stopped for futility and market doubts manufacturing fix, STS data (51.5% vs ~15%) is show-me; $99M cash is 3.8x $26M cap, w 2.2 quarters of runway.
pit.SLGL: Patidegib's Ph3 topline lands in late November w a 9% dropout rate and US rights retained, but a $180M cap is 3.3x our $54M weighted peak, so payoff skews to a miss.
pit.AURA: CoMpass enrolled 108 patients (above target) under an SPA w topline 2H 2027, and bel-sar faces no approved vision-sparing 1L rival; still, an $802M cap vs $297M cash leaves limited room before binary.
pit.PLRX: 1 CR and 2 PRs in n=16 ICI-refractory patients (vs ~10% historical) earn nothing, w cash 3.4x $50M cap; Mar-2027 Ph1b interim is re-rate in a crowded space.
pit.CYTK: MYQORZO label update Nov 16; nHCM sNDA Q4; $7.2B cap 2.1x peak estimate; debt-like liabilities.
pit.LGVN: ELPIS II (n=40) missed primary RVEF at Month 12 (p=0.8336); a MACE signal (1 vs 8) is secondary, FDA meeting is unscheduled, and $7.2M cash lasts into Q1 2027 against a $68M cap, so dilution looks likely.
pit.IKT: No efficacy data yet for an imatinib prodrug in PAH; Part A (n=50) in 1H27 is safety only, $291M cap is 1.5x $193M cash, and any add-on must beat sotatercept's data w tolerability that sank Gleevec.
pit.ABSI: Only SAD safety and a ~65-day half-life exist so far, yet $1.3B cap is ~4x $325M weighted peak (13% x $2.5B); Dec 2026 13-week AGA interim must also face finasteride and MANE's VDPHL01.
pit.FBIO: The $205M PRV sale (closed Mar 2026) and $152M cash against a $57M cap price ZYCUBO and Journey derm near zero; holding-company structure and 3.8 quarters of runway explain discount.
pit.LCTX: OpRegen showed +6.2 ETDRS letters and RPE re-appearance at 36 months, but in n=5 uncontrolled; $202M cap is 1.5x weighted peak and Ph2a has no guided data date, so patience is call.
pit.KOD: Ph3 wins in wet AMD (p=0.0007, 54% at 6-month dosing) and DR support a Q4 BLA, but only non-inferiority to aflibercept, KSI-101 PEAK binary in Dec, and $89M cash vs a $6.3B cap mean dilution risk.
pit.SGP: BIM-IOL's FIH shows 37% mean IOP reduction and 86% off drops at 4 years, yet it is small and Ph3s only finish enrolling in 2027; a $1.1B cap is 2.0x weighted peak, though $216M cash funds through 2028.
pit.ARDX: IBSRELA grew 23% to $96.3M in Q3 but FY26 guidance was cut to $350-370M on payer friction; $823M cap is ~1.6x annualized revenue, and ACCEL Ph3 in CIC reads out 2H27.
pit.NSRX: Faster PK than EpiPen (T100 1.69 vs 3.47 min) is real, but w $0 cash and a pivotal still to fund, $35M cap is ~2x its $17M probability-weighted peak; dilution comes first.
pit.EVMN: EVO756 missed all endpoints in AD (n=121) and CSU, leaving EVO301 (Ph2a n=70, EASI -55% vs -22%) w a Ph2b not until mid-2027. Cash of $262M props up a $304M cap, but runway is ~10 quarters and AD is crowded; upside is not credible.
pit.ABVX: Obefazimod's 39.3% placebo-adjusted maintenance remission tops oral UC peers and NDA is due by end-2026; at $6.7B vs ~$5.9B weighted peak, debate is launch share, not efficacy.
pit.MNKD: Q3 revenue grew 24% to $101.9M (Afrezza $19.3M, Furoscix $22.4M, ReadyFlow ~75% of shipments), yet $567M debt vs $97M cash and a $1.3B cap resting on royalties leave little room until Afrezza pediatric uptake shows.
pit.MAZE: MZE829 hit -35.6% mean uACR (FSGS -61.8% vs inaxaplin ~43%), open-label n=12-15; but a $2.0B cap is 4.7x our $430M weighted peak, so watch final data early 2027 and pivotal start.
pit.ACET: 7-patient allogeneic CAR-T lupus signal stays intact and is cash-backed ($138M, ~5x $28M cap); slipped data timing and durability are risks.
pit.ATYR: Ph3 EFZO-FIT missed (p=0.33); new FVC-primary Ph3 rests on a 44-patient post-hoc subgroup and depends on a licensee. $514M cap vs $50M cash after a ~530% 12-month run.
pit.IMUX: Both relapsing-MS Ph3s (1,121 and 1,100 pts) are fully enrolled w futility passed; topline Dec 2026, NDA mid-2027 if positive. $307M cap vs $132M cash, 4.4 quarters, against ocrelizumab and ofatumumab.
pit.CRDL: Pivotal withdrawal-design MAVERIC (enrollment up to 150 pts, done end Q4 2026) reads Aug 2027-Feb 2028; cap is 0.4x weighted peak, yet $29M cash needs funding and ARCALYST sets bar.
pit.PHAR: Joenja +58% to $23.8M Q3; guidance cut; CEO left; cap ~$0.86B; PDUFA Jan 30 2027.
pit.NKTR: REZPEG hit its Ph2b (n=393, p<0.001, Lancet) w durable maintenance, and ~$300M of implied pipeline value is modest; cost is a long wait for Ph3 topline in mid-2028 against dupilumab.
pit.IFRX: Izicopan has only Ph1 safety/PK/PD and a 4-week HS/CSU Ph2a signal, w ~35-per-arm renal AAV Ph2 starting early 2027. With a $174M cap against $179M cash, market ascribes little to a ~12% PoS asset, so option value is cheap.
pit.CUE: Randomized CSU Ph2 (n=145) gave 54/53/43% responders vs 11% placebo, yet $149M cap on a 20% PoS needs a raise: $58M cash is 3.4 quarters before global Ph2b/3 starts.
pit.ARTV: After Oct 27 AlloNK discontinuation and strategic review (no timing guided), cash is ~1.6x $202M cap; value hinges on outcome and burn, not on any clinical event.
pit.MCRB: 77% cut in bloodstream infections in allo-HSCT (Breakthrough) at $14M cap, below $18M cash, but ~1.5 quarters of runway and an unfunded pivotal Ph2 make it a financing-gated option.
pit.ABUS: Moderna has paid $950M (Arbutus share $178.4M) and up to $1.3B more hinges on 28 USC 1498 ruling, argued Nov 5 w no date; imdusiran's 8 functional cures sit in an enriched subset of a crowded field.
pit.ENTA: Zelicapavir cut hospitalization to 1.7% vs 5.0% and symptoms 6.7 days faster in a high-risk Ph2b subset; cap less cash is ~$116M while RESOLVE dosing starts and LOTUS reads 1Q 2027.
pit.INO: VOCERYQ won accelerated approval for RRP (81% fewer surgeries at 52 wk, n=32) w shipping about late Dec; a $336M cap is 1.7x $202M peak estimate and cash is only $48M.
pit.BHC: With $20.2B debt (6.3x $3.2B cap), Xifaxan generics expected in 2028 and RED-C failed, larsucosterol (Ph2b missed survival primary, BTD, Ph3 in planning) is a minor option.
pit.INKT: Randomized ARDS Ph2 reads out in 2H26 and a win would dwarf $51M cap, but $10M cash (3.5 quarters) means any pop is likely funded by dilution; binary w a financing tail.
pit.CTNM: With $245M cash funding to mid-2029, downside looks cushioned, yet PROPEL-IPF (n~324) has no guided topline, PIPE-791 is behind admilparant, and pain crossover showed no clear significance.
pit.ENTX: EB613 has a Ph2 (n=161) and FDA-accepted single Ph3 (~750 women, hip BMD at 12 months); $266M cash funds it into 2030, so a $599M cap vs $5.9B peak estimate rests on execution, not financing.
pit.EDIT: EDIT-401 has only NHP data (~90% LDL-C cut) and GLP tox is ongoing; first dosing by YE2026, safety data Q1 2027. Verve is 2-3 years ahead in humans; $289M cap is 3.5x $82M weighted peak.
pit.RARE: Crysvita ($109M of $173M Q3 revenue) anchors a $730-760M FY26 guide; GENGLYCOS and FAYUVI launched and GTX-102 is wound down. Cap $1.6B is ~2.2x sales against $401M cash and $1.2B debt.
pit.RZLT: upLIFT topline lands mid-Dec 2026 on a single-arm, open-label n=16 study after congenital-HI Ph3 missed; $375M cap vs $18M peak (~21x) and $90M cash leaves no cushion for a miss.
pit.AMRN: The $238M cap is below $323M of cash, three straight quarters of positive cash flow and a completed $70M+ cost program, w a strategic review pending; US sales are flat near $36M a quarter.
pit.RYTM: Imcivree sells ($92M a quarter) and TRANSCEND was positive, but an extended PDUFA and EMANATE miss leave bivamelagon Ph3 (start by YE2026) carrying a $7.7B cap, 3.6x our $2.2B weighted peak.
pit.VANI: SLIM-1 (n=10 per arm, 4 wks): weight loss 0.79% vs 0.82% on Wegovy, 0/10 vs 5/10 AEs; a financing is near-term issue w $15M cash vs $95M cap, though Novo evaluation adds option value.
pit.EWTX: EDG-7500 no LVEF drop (n=53, open-label); $4.8B cap 3.3x weighted peak; Ph3 Q4.
pit.CAPR: FDA panel voted 3-9 against effectiveness for cardiomyopathy, so Capricor narrowed to upper limb, where HOPE-3 (n=106) showed 54% slowing, p=0.03. The Nov 22 decision is binary; $199M cash is 41% of $483M cap, w an activist pushing board.
pit.MENS: The US API-1 pivotal failed vs placebo and original source is unavailable, so a comparability study delays a combined NDA to 2029-2030; $1M cash vs $135M cap means near-term dilution.
pit.STOK: Zorevunersen's ~80% durable seizure cut plus cognitive gains argue for call, w no approved disease-modifier in SCN1A Dravet; but EMPEROR topline is not until Q3 2027 and cash is $359M.
pit.DSGN: The $635M cap is 3.0x its $209M cash and 4.8x our ~$133M weighted peak (15% x $875M) on 4-week data, w 12-week durability due Q1 2027 and Larimar's BLA already submitted.
pit.AVXL: The EMA MAA was withdrawn Mar 25 after a negative CHMP and a new US Ph3 has no start date; cash of $118M (1.6x $76M cap) is no floor for a stock down 86% in 12 months.
pit.COYA: No efficacy data until 24-week ALSTARS topline (early Q2 2027, 137 pts, fully enrolled); $36M cash is about half $70M cap and funds only into 2H 2027; AMX0035 and tofersen are approved.
pit.ATHE: FDA allowed one ~200-pt pivotal Ph3 on 50 mg dose, yet Ph3 is unfunded and 75 mg was not significant; w $27M cash vs a $431M cap, partnering or a raise comes before any start.
pit.IGC: Almost no cash (about 0.1 quarter of runway) ahead of CALMA topline; interim CMAI -10.45 at p=0.071 is borderline, so dilution risk outweighs $19M cap.
pit.TNXP: Tonmya is ramping (Q2 $11.0M, +197% QoQ), yet 3.8 quarters of runway at ~$40M quarterly burn means financing, not demand, sets path; cash of $163M is 3.1x $52M cap.
pit.CING: CTx-1301 met Ph3 endpoints and drew a manufacturing-only CRL (Jun 2026); resubmission is due Dec 2026-Jan 2027. $55M cap vs $23M cash (3.4 quarters runway) in a crowded stimulant field.
pit.SPTX: Well funded ($404M, runway into 2029) but a $1.0B cap already credits GlyphAllo before any Ph2b efficacy; BUOY-1 (up to 360 pts) reads 1H 2027 against approved zuranolone.
pit.LBRX: Faster NOVA-2 enrollment pulled topline to 1H 2027; $1.5B cap vs $404M cash and ~$2.4B weighted peak (65% x $3.75B), w bar set by cheap D2 generics and Cobenfy.
pit.ACHV: Cytisinicline's June CRL was CMC and labeling only; ORCA-2 abstinence was 32.6% vs 7.0% and 52-wk quit rates reached 31.2%. Resubmission is on track for Q4 2026; $667M cap vs $202M cash.
pit.BLSM: SOLARA's 45% ORR (18/40) and 88% DCR in C797S+ NSCLC are encouraging, yet single-arm w 6.9-mo follow-up; $434M cap is 1.9x $225M cash, and pivotal SOLARA-2 starts Q1 2027.
pit.YARW: YB-101 (anti-TSHR, Fast Track) is dosing but has no efficacy data until 2H 2027; $490M cap is 2.2x $225M weighted peak, softened by $269M cash and runway into 2030. A wait for Ph2a proof of concept.
pit.ADRX: Cash is 60% of $1.5B cap, but human efficacy is n=3 open-label; cap is 2.7x our $560M weighted peak, and Ph3 STOP-HAE (~90 pts) reads out by YE2027 against Takeda and Ionis.
pit.LYCA: A $1.6B cap after an October IPO rests on 96% free-IgE cut in ~8 healthy atopics (per press), 15x our $108M PoS-weighted peak; Xolair already depletes IgE and lock-up expiry looms.
pit.KROS: Cash exceeds $199M cap by 1.3x, yet cibotercept failed in PAH and rinvatercept has Ph1 healthy-volunteer biomarkers only in DMD. First Ph2 patient dosed Sep 28, data mid-2027, and prior myostatin drugs missed on function; 20% PoS.
pit.ADCT: The 2L path is being reassessed after stock fell 57% on LOTIS-5; Zynlonta sells ~$21M a quarter, and Roche and BMS options win on survival. Cap $271M vs $189M cash and $420M debt.
pit.CTOR: Prelim fiscal Q4 showed 792 wholesaler units, 950 vials ordered and 54 institutions (44 in Aug); mogamulizumab dominates CTCL, and a $57M cap w $17M cash needs financing soon.
pit.SLBT: SL Science has no clinical data: FDA found its CD19 Armed-T packages insufficient and glioblastoma IND is not targeted until Q3 2027. A $404M cap is 50x $8M cash against $1.39M of H1 revenue.
pit.PRLD: PRT12396 sits under an Incyte option expiring Feb 2027 w first data unguided, and PRT13722 only just entered Ph1; cash is 45% of $335M cap after a 109% 12-month run.
pit.KPTI: SENTRY hit SVR35 (49.8% vs 28%) but missed TSS co-primary w Grade 3+ AEs 70% vs 50%; w $91M cash dwarfing a ~$1M micro-cap, SVR-only sNDA is a cheap binary on FDA.
pit.ADAG: Cash covers 96% of $134M cap while muzastotug posted 31% ORR at 20mg/kg (n=26) in MSS CRC, though 10mg/kg fell to 13%. Agenus's exit from MSS-CRC (a strategic funding stop, not futility) helps; 60-patient randomized Ph2 reads 1H 2027.
pit.AGEN: NEST showed 32% pCR w no recurrences at median 32.2 mo, but ROBBIN Ph3 has not started (first patient Q1 2027) and $85M upfront funds only into Q3 2027; $87M cash vs $239M debt makes dilution swing factor.
pit.LNTH: With Curium paying $102.50 cash plus a CVR up to $12 (close 1H 2027), $7.0B cap tracks deal terms; FTC extended HSR review Oct 21, and Pylarify sales were flat (-0.7%) at $238.9M.
pit.TVRD: H2 HCC topline is binary: only biomarker/PK data, a hard STAT3 history and a going-concern flag mean a stock trading at about its $16M cash is no floor.
pit.RLMD: NDV-01 showed 94% anytime CR (48/51) and 86% 18-mo durability (12/14), yet needs an IND by YE2026 while CGON is ~2 years ahead; cash is $202M, 52% of $385M cap.
pit.ORIC: Rinzimetostat plus darolutamide holds 59% landmark rPFS at 8-10 mo post-abiraterone w no Gr4/5 AEs, and Ph3 is enrolling ~600 pts; $815M cap vs $345M cash, funded into 2H 2028.
pit.RLAY: Zovegalisib's 11.1mo mPFS (n=57) and Breakthrough status are real, but cross-trial; $3.8B cap vs $849M cash and Ph3 ReDiscover-2 against approved capivasertib leave little room; the Dec 14 ASH data are vascular anomalies, not breast.
pit.TELO: Preclinical metal chelator w zero human data: $36M cap is still 72% of $50M peak estimate on only $6M of cash, so dilution comes well before any clinical proof.
pit.MGNX: MGC026 has cleared SCCHN Stage 1 (n=74 enrolled, no ILD or ocular toxicity), but ifinatamab deruxtecan is ~2 years ahead and MacroGenics' prior ADCs disappointed; cash $288M vs $139M cap.
pit.PMVP: Rezatapopt posted 46% ORR (35/76, median DOR 10.0 mo) in TP53 Y220C ovarian w no approved rival; $90M cap is 0.8x cash and ~0.65x ~$139M weighted peak, though runway is just 6 quarters.
pit.PYXS: MICVO monotherapy: 36% cORR, 94% DCR, mPFS 6.2mo (n=33); 30% x $750M is ~$225M vs $169M cap, w Dec 2026 1L pembro data and Q1 2027 FDA EOP2 feedback ahead, and $57M cash (9/30) predates an ~$110M Oct raise.
pit.AVBP: After FURVENT missed PFS (HR 0.75, p=0.0654, despite 60% vs 33% ORR), Dizal/AstraZeneca's sunvozertinib leads 1L ex20ins; $393M cash is 65% of $602M cap, leaving ALPACCA as remaining thesis, w a Q1 2027 update.
pit.FHTX: Lilly ended FHD-909 in Oct 2026, leaving a preclinical EP300 degrader (IND 2027, no human data); 1.2x cash cover sits against 7.4 quarters of runway, so burn eats floor.
pit.EIKN: EIK1001 + pembro + chemo showed 63.1% ORR (n=65) vs ~40-47% for SoC, but single-arm; $292M cap is under $462M cash, and randomized Ph2/3 interim (2H 2027) is real test.
pit.IMTX: Cash of $536M covers 55% of $966M cap, so market pays about $430M for anzu-cel (56% cORR, 14.6-month mDOR) versus our ~$810M weighted peak; lifileucel is about 1.5 years ahead.
pit.HURA: Preliminary MCC data due 1H 2027; Ph3 enrollment slipped to 2H 2027; cash $2M vs $9M debt (0.3 quarters), so a raise is near-certain before either.
pit.ERAS: ERAS-0015 57% uORR PDAC, 62% NSCLC (unconfirmed Ph1); $5.3B cap; Ph3 2027.
pit.FENC: PEDMARK Q3 net sales rose 56% to $19.4M w $5.8M adj EBITDA, and cash is $49M. Yet $484M cap is 3.2x our $150M peak, so a niche, formulary-driven ramp is needed just to hold value.
pit.LXEO: At 1.3x cash ($293M cap vs $234M) market pays little for LX2006's frataxin +115% data; 13-vs-13 pivotal reads in Aug 2027, BLA 2028, and nomlabofusp's BLA is ~18 months ahead.
pit.MLYS: Two positive pivotals and a Dec-22 PDUFA at 90% PoS; $1.3B cap (2.1x $625M cash) is 0.5x $2.8B peak, though as #2 behind AstraZeneca's approved baxdrostat, payer terms set ramp.
pit.GOSS: PROSERA missed (p=0.032 vs 0.025); ~$67M cap; $57M cash, $84M debt; runway ~1.4 quarters.
pit.CNXU: CXU has only unreviewed preclinical data, $7M of cash (3.8 quarters) on a $59M cap, and a 510(k) not expected until early 2027, against commercial filler makers; funding precedes any revenue.
pit.INCY: Povorcitinib's 54-week HS data (up to 71.4% HiSCR50) and a Q1 2027 US launch are real, yet a $25B cap sits on ~$5.3B of guided net sales, so HS reads as incremental, not re-rating.
pit.OCUL: AXPAXLI SOL-1 met its superiority-design primary (p=0.0006) and pre-NDA meeting is done; at a $1.4B cap vs ~$2.9B weighted peak stock is cheap against filing risk; SOL-R in 2028 is durability test.
pit.OCS: After OCS-01 failed Ph3 in DME, privosegtor has BTD, PRIME and ACUITY data (+18 letters LCVA); $282M cash is 60% of $471M cap and no NAION drug is approved, so skew favors upside.
pit.TARS: XDEMVY sold $194.6M in Q3 (+64% y/y; $513.9M YTD, >$1B cumulative) and has no direct Demodex competitor; a $3.9B cap is ~5x annualized Q3 sales, w Ph2 pipeline toplines in 1H 2027.
pit.NRXS: Revenue is doubling (Q2 $1.9M, +116%) on a new CPT code, and $75M cap is ~0.4x $211M risk-weighted peak, but $8M cash and 4 quarters of runway make dilution real risk.
pit.PHVS: On-demand NDA has an Apr 23 2027 PDUFA and prophylaxis cut attacks 83% (n=85), but $2.3B is 2.0x our $1.1B weighted peak, w $321M cash and KalVista's Ekterly already approved.
pit.JSPR: Dual-action complement drug for PNH (controlling both types of red-cell destruction); $7.3M cash against a $13M cap makes it a distressed micro-cap, though low price flatters long.
pit.SYRE: SKYLINE Part A hit for SPY001, SPY002 and SPY003, yet it was open-label and differentiation is convenience; at $9.4B vs $1.1B cash, Part B randomized topline (Q3 2027) must justify ~4.8x weighted peak.
pit.SANA: The 14-month UP421 result is one patient w donor islets, not SC451; a $577M cap is 1.8x $325M weighted peak, Vertex is far ahead, and $122M cash runs only to mid-2027, implying financing before 2027 data.
pit.TVTX: FILSPARI grew 120% to $200.2M in Q3 w 1,932 new starts and FSGS now approved, yet a $4.8B cap is 3.7x $1.3B peak estimate against Tarpeyo, Fabhalta and newcomers; HARMONY Ph3 in 2H 2027.
pit.ELOX: Readthrough agent w n=3 Alport biopsy responses; $146M cap is fairly priced against 0.4x cash, funded into 2028, and 24-patient EXACT Ph2b 16-week topline (mid-2027) is real test.
pit.DNTH: $5.1B cap is ~2.1x our $2.5B weighted peak on Ph2 gMG data alone; EMERGE Ph3 reads 2H 2028, MMN Ph2 topline Dec 2026. $1.2B cash covers 32 quarters, but gMG has argenx, UCB and Alexion in place.
pit.TLSA: Foralumab met its microglial PET primary at 50 ug only (n=48, EDSS unchanged), and w $1M of cash against an $85M cap FDA meeting matters less than next financing.
pit.MIRM: With FY26 guidance of $715-720M, $6.0B is ~8.4x sales and $731M debt sits against $501M cash; FDA wants a new PSC Ph3, so brelovitug HDV topline in Q4 carries near-term upside.
pit.PRME: PM577a, a one-time Wilson's fix, dosed its first patient Oct 5 w data in 2027; a $760M cap is 0.8x $912M weighted peak, and $143.7M Nov raise funds it through 2027, so it is a wait for data.
pit.ACRS: After bosakitug missed in AD on Nov 16, ATI-052 (Ph1b: AD EASI -45% placebo-adjusted, asthma FeNO -59%) carries company; EoE Ph2b starts Q1 2027. A $565M cap is 2.8x cash and ~2.8x our $200M weighted peak, so we wait for Ph2b data.
pit.AVTX: LOTUS (n=253) hit at both doses, HiSCR75 42.2%/42.9% vs 25.6% placebo, yet stock is -35% in a month and trades below its $463M cash. FDA feedback on Ph3 plan is due by YE 2026; bimekizumab's ~49-50% is bar to clear.
pit.ZBIO: INDIGO cut flare risk 56% (HR 0.44, p=0.0005) and BLA is accepted; yet $1.9B cap vs $647M cash and $399M debt leans on IgG4-RD (modest) plus unproven SLE Ph2 topline due Q4 2026.
pit.KYTX: SPS BLA completed Nov 12 w priority review sought; KYSA-8 (n=26) showed 49% T25FW gain and 92% off chronic therapy. $301M cap vs $171M cash; no approved SPS drug, but runway is 4.4 quarters.
pit.PYPD: With approval at 90% PoS in our model and Azurity prepping an early 2027 launch, $130M vs $400M peak is upside; offset is just $16M cash (~2.7 quarters), so financing follows PDUFA.
pit.AVIR: C-BEYOND matched Epclusa on SVR24 (93.9% vs 94.8%), and 8 weeks sufficed in non-cirrhotic patients; $191M cash is 58% of a $331M cap. C-FORWARD topline early 2027 sets up a mid-2027 NDA.
pit.IVVD: LIBERTY was positive (n=210) and DECLARATION interim is imminent, but it reports titers, PK and safety, not efficacy; $126M cash is 79% of $160M cap w ~3.2 quarters of runway.
pit.NNVC: Zero human efficacy data, $3M cash (~1.6 quarters) against a $33M cap, and an Ebola/mpox pivot that adds headlines rather than evidence; dilution is base case.
pit.GYRE: Ph3 showed Ishak fibrosis regression; NDA is in NMPA priority review w conditional approval path and no approved China CHB competitor. $99M cash, $33M quarterly revenue.
pit.VCRE: Passing iDMC futility look de-risks ASPIRE only modestly; AIR Ph2a +23 mL FVC (n=48, vs external control) was uncontrolled. $286M cap vs $879M weighted peak, but $77M cash is 5.5 quarters.
pit.RNTX: Inhaled IPF peptide w promising biomarker data but no controlled efficacy yet; $44M cash roughly matches $35M micro-cap, still unproven.
pit.RDY: Semaglutide generics (non-inferior HbA1c, n=312) approved in 10 countries w supply resuming Nov 2026, plus an abatacept biosimilar PDUFA on Dec 22; $12B cap vs ~$6.8B weighted peak.
pit.PTCT: Q3 revenue $357.8M (Sephience $181.9M, +20% q/q) and FY26 guidance of $1.29-1.32B are a real base; yet $5.1B cap is 3.4x $1.5B peak estimate and Novartis controls votoplam in HD.
pit.ZVRA: MIPLYFFA is only approved NPC drug and booked $34.0M in Q3, but total revenue fell from $39.7M in Q2 to $37.8M. Cash of $271M is 49% of $550M cap; infant sNDA is due Q1 2027, and celiprolol Ph3 has 72 patients enrolled.
pit.XERS: Recorlev grew 93% to $71.5M and total Q3 revenue rose 44% to $107.2M, w FY26 guided to $395-405M; a $3.1B cap is ~7.6x that, and XP-8121 Ph3 topline is late 2028. Cash $131M, debt $190M.
pit.MDGL: Rezdiffra's Q3 sales of $431.3M (+50% YoY, >55,850 patients) and first profitable quarter ($55.4M) de-risk launch; $9.8B cap is ~1.9x our $5.2B peak, so F4c cirrhosis data (late 2027) and GLP-1 MASH share carry upside.
pit.VKTX: VK2735 posted 14.7% (SC) and 12.2% (oral) weight loss at 13 weeks; w $960M cash $3.4B cap is ~1.8x $1.9B weighted peak, so VANQUISH completion in 2027 must beat tirzepatide to re-rate.
pit.GUTS: Pivotal 6-month win (n=308, p=0.0023, no device SAEs); De Novo filing late Q4. Runway reaches only Q2 2027, so a raise likely accompanies 12-month data; $151M cap vs $47M cash.
pit.DYN: BLA on Priority Review w a Jan 21 2027 PDUFA; dystrophin rose from 0.83% to 5.46% vs Sarepta's ~1%. At $3.1B cap is 2.1x our $1.5B peak, cushioned by $1.1B cash, so gains hinge on 53/45 multi-exon and DM1 programs.
pit.CPIX: After selling its brands to Apotex for $100M and paying a $1.50 special dividend, Cumberland trades at $78M vs $81M cash. Ifetroban showed a ~5.4% LVEF benefit in 41 DMD patients, but no Ph3 design or funding has been announced.
pit.XENE: X-TOLE2 showed -42.7% placebo-adjusted (p<0.0001) and NDA went in Sep 17 w a filing decision due mid-Nov; market has marked down psychiatry pause, leaving ~$2.7B of enterprise value on epilepsy.
pit.CAMP: The $350M cap is 2.8x cash of $125M for a program w only seizure-model data; trials are cleared in Australia, Argentina, UK and EU, and cap is 3.4x ~$104M weighted peak (12% x $875M), leaving no margin for a human miss.
pit.NGEN: NVG-291 showed GRASSP +3.7 vs +0.4 placebo (n~24, p=0.0155) in chronic SCI and now has Breakthrough designation; cash of $57M (29% of $196M cap) is guided to last 12 quarters, past 1H 2028 RESTORE topline.
pit.VYGR: Cash of $132M is 1.3x $101M cap going into VY7523 tau-PET data (Q4 2026) and VY1706 safety (Q1 2027); anti-tau efficacy is unproven and UCB and J&J are well funded.
pit.MNOV: Topline from 234-patient COMBAT-ALS Ph2b/3 is due by end of 2026; $66M cap vs $29M cash and a ~$34M weighted peak (19% x $180M), against approved AMX0035 and tofersen.
pit.ACIU: VacSYn Ph2 (n=34) met safety and immunogenicity endpoints w antibodies in CSF, and cash is 65% of cap; efficacy is unproven, runway ends Q4 2027, and a CEO search is under way.
pit.LXRX: INPEFA, a dual SGLT1/2, is up against genericizing SGLT2s, so $779M cap (4.3x $183M cash) rides on SONATA-HCM Ph3 topline and Zynquista NDA resubmission, both Q1 2027, plus Novo's LX9851 obesity deal.
pit.SCLX: Distressed: $3M cash against a $12M cap, a stockholders' deficit and SEMDEXA NDA slipped to 2027; 77% drop does not make it cheap, since dilution or insolvency is base case.
pit.NMRA: Cap $70M vs $86M cash and $55M debt; Ph1b showed a 15.7-point CMAI reduction and Ph2 is enabled, but no start date, 2.8 quarters of runway and a failed navacaprant mean financing precedes any rerating.
pit.ANRO: Alto's biomarker-selected ALTO-207 has only a 32-patient Ph2a (d=1.1), and $1.3B cap is 2x 27% x $2.4B weighted peak; PACE-2 Ph3 starts early 2027, PACE-1 topline 2H 2027, ALTO-101 missed.
pit.VNDA: Q3 net product sales of $69.8M and FY26 guidance above $240M sit against a $230M cap and $141M cash; Quimilza PDUFA Dec 12 and BYSANTI's launch vs entrenched generics decide it.
pit.BRVE: A $1.8B cap is 2.1x $840M weighted peak (28% x $3B) for a Ph3 myosin inhibitor behind mavacamten, aficamten and EDG-7500; Hengrui China Ph3 topline 1H27 is first efficacy test, $504M cash buys time only.
pit.SCTX: STX-1150 cut LDL-C >50% in NHPs for nearly 18 months, but cap of $291M is already ~0.8x our $350M weighted peak and Verve/Lilly lead in clinic; Ph1 SAD data (1H27) is first human test.
pit.SER: Once-daily SC apomorphine faces AbbVie's Vyalev, w Ph1 SAD data only in 1H27; $25M cash is 71% of $35M cap, but convenience-only differentiation and dilution risk say pass.
pit.KRSA: No human data until Ph1 healthy-volunteer results in mid-2027; a $1.8B cap already assumes shuttle works and beats Roche's Ph3 trontinemab; $456M cash funds into 2029.
pit.CTY: Biomarker-only Ph1 (85% FXI knockdown, no bleeding or VTE endpoints) in a field led by Bayer, BMS/J&J and Anthos/Novartis; $968M cap is 6.8x cash of $142M w 4.7 quarters of runway. ASH data Dec 12.
pit.RTSN: Ph2b SBP data in 1H27 follows an n=40 pilot w p-values but no mmHg effect disclosed; a thin-float $89M cap, lock-up expiry ~Apr 2027 and likely further financing weigh against baxdrostat/lorundrostat.
